sloka: गृध्रौ द्वौ दृष्ट पूर्वौ मे मातरिश्व समौ जवे ।गृध्राणाम् चैव राजानौ भ्रातरौ काम रूपिणौ ॥४-६०-१९॥
transliteration: gṛdhrau dvau dṛṣṭa pūrvau me mātariśva samau jave ।gṛdhrāṇām caiva rājānau bhrātarau kāma rūpiṇau ॥4-60-19॥

translations.english: 'You are the king among vultures equal to wind in speed.I had seen both the brothers earlier and both of you could change your form at will.
